abilities.description:
Plant Spore

Area healing

Plant a healing spore on visible ground. Its pulses restore nearby allies, so place it where your party can gather. Verdancy regenerates naturally; basic staff attacks are free.
abilities.name: Plant Spore

abilities.description:
Renewing Touch

Healing over time

Restore a friendly player's health over time. Keep the effect on allies who need steady support while you plant spores or change form.
abilities.name: Renewing Touch

abilities.description:
Lifebloom

Focused restoration

Send focused healing toward a friendly player. Nature supports your party from range, while Guardian and Briarwolf give you protection and pursuit when the fight changes.
abilities.name: Lifebloom

abilities.description:
Swipe

Cleave attack

Sweep your claws through enemies in front of you. Face the group before striking to catch several enemies in one attack.
abilities.name: Swipe

abilities.description:
Challenge Roar

Protect your party

Roar to draw enemy creatures' attention and take pressure off your allies. The Brambleguard talent offers a different protection option as your build develops.
abilities.name: Challenge Roar

abilities.description:
Barkward

Defensive ability

Harden your bark for a brief defensive window. Time it before a heavy attack. Build signature energy to unlock Ancient Stand, another tool for holding the front line.
abilities.name: Barkward

abilities.description:
Pounce

Leaping attack

Leap at a nearby enemy to close the distance and enter melee combat. Pounce needs a target and a clear route.
abilities.name: Pounce

abilities.description:
Prowl

Stealth ability

Conceal yourself and choose your approach. Attacking reveals you, so wait for an opening before committing. Talents can extend your hunting window.
abilities.name: Prowl

abilities.description:
Thorn Frenzy

Empowered attacks

Build signature energy by landing attacks or healing injured allies, then unleash a frenzy of empowered attacks. Follow up with wolf strikes and a charged Rend.
abilities.name: Thorn Frenzy

abilities.description:
Rage Strike

Heavy finishing strike

Build Rage through combat. At full Rage, land a charged battleaxe hit to unleash Rage Strike. Look for an opening where you can commit to the attack.
abilities.name: Rage Strike

abilities.description:
Battleaxe Throw

Ranged weapon attack

Hurl your battleaxe at an enemy beyond your normal swing. Mix throws with close-range attacks and guarding to keep pressure on your target.
abilities.name: Battleaxe Throw

abilities.description:
Bloodrush

Close-combat pressure

Bloodrush is Fury's starting combat ability. Later talents can replace it with Ravager or Undying Rage, letting you shape your battleaxe build as you level.
abilities.name: Bloodrush

abilities.description:
Punch combinations

Flowing melee combos

Chain three-hit punch strings to build Chi. Gold orbs above your hotbar show available Chi; dark orbs have been spent. Charged kicks give you another way to finish an exchange.
abilities.name: Punch combinations

abilities.description:
Backflip Kick

Strike and disengage

Land a kick and flip away to create space. Weave it between punch combinations or use it after a charged kick, then choose your next approach.
abilities.name: Backflip Kick

abilities.description:
Inner Focus

Disciplined fist combat

Inner Focus is Perfection's starting combat ability. Talents offer other choices as your build develops. Combine your chosen ability with Chi-building punches, charged kicks and Backflip Kick.
abilities.name: Inner Focus

abilities.description:
Blessed Strike

Fight to restore allies

Land a damaging club attack to heal one injured nearby party member. Keep fighting between support casts; your weapon strikes help keep the party standing.
abilities.name: Blessed Strike

abilities.description:
Intercession

Holy support

Support your party with Intercession while building your own spell loadout. It has a separate cooldown from your selected spells. Your build also gives you Healing Hymn or Daybreak.
abilities.name: Intercession

abilities.description:
Healing & holy spells

Build your support loadout

Choose one learned spell per slot. Begin with Touch of Life or Shield of Faith, then learn damage spells, prayers and party protection. Each slot has its own cooldown, with a short pause between casts. Shield of Faith needs no physical shield.
abilities.name: Healing & holy spells

abilities.description:
Radiant Judgment

Draw enemy attention

Strike a target to taunt nearby enemy creatures and pull pressure away from your party. Other players keep control of whom they attack.
abilities.name: Radiant Judgment

abilities.description:
Bulwark Advance

Shield charge

Advance up to six blocks behind your shield, spending 40 Resolve. Guard hostile attacks to build Resolve first. Learned at level five.
abilities.name: Bulwark Advance

abilities.description:
Stand Against the Void

Hold the front line

Hope's defensive ability supports its sword-and-shield fighting style. Combine it with guarding, Resolve and Radiant Judgment to give your allies room to act.
abilities.name: Stand Against the Void

abilities.description:
Kunai

Ranged pressure

Combine thrown kunai with sword attacks. Talents can strengthen kunai, backstabs, control or sustained sword combat, giving you several ways to punish an opening.
abilities.name: Kunai

abilities.description:
Grapple

Swing into position

Throw a grapple to reach a new position. Swing around an anchor or pull yourself straight toward it, then detach to carry your momentum into your next move.
abilities.name: Grapple

abilities.description:
Smoke Veil

Conceal your approach

Hide your approach with Smoke Veil, Shinobi's starting concealment ability. Use your grapple to choose an angle and strike when your target is exposed.
abilities.name: Smoke Veil

abilities.description:
Rot

Infect and exploit

Build Rot and Darkness, then exploit the infection with charged dagger attacks and talents. Each Void Rogue builds their own Rot; another player's infection cannot fuel your attacks.
abilities.name: Rot

abilities.description:
Shadow Dodge

Elusive movement

Dash while preserving your momentum. An extra aerial jump gives you another way to reposition. Combine both to move around your target and escape pressure.
abilities.name: Shadow Dodge

abilities.description:
Cloak

Brief concealment

Vanish for up to four seconds. Attacking or taking damage reveals you, so choose your opening carefully. The Night Tide talent replaces Cloak with a longer concealment and a moving decoy.
abilities.name: Cloak

abilities.description:
Cinderstep

Lift off on flame

Ignite jets beneath your feet to hover and steer a glide. Keep the jets burning to stay aloft; stop thrusting to descend. Costs 10 mana to start, then 15 per second after the first second. There is no cooldown.
abilities.name: Cinderstep

abilities.description:
Incarnation

Become living fire

Take on a living flame form for eight seconds. Sol spell damage rises by 35%, Burn damage by 50%, and Sol mana costs fall by 30%. Costs 60 mana with a 30-second base cooldown. Keep casting while it lasts.
abilities.name: Incarnation

abilities.description:
Fire spell loadout

Burn and overwhelm

Learn fire bolts, Flame Jet or Backdraft, Flashover or Pyre, and Meteor Swarm or Cataclysm. Choose one learned spell per slot. Set enemies burning before using spells that gain extra damage from your Burn.
abilities.name: Fire spell loadout

abilities.description:
Tide Lash

Drench your enemies

Strike enemies to build up to three Soaked stacks. Breaker Wave and damaging control spells consume your stacks for added damage. Charged staff orbs cost no mana.
abilities.name: Tide Lash

abilities.description:
Breaker Wave

Send a wave or ride it

Send a wave ahead to hit enemies, or ride it across land and water to change position. Step off while the wave keeps travelling. Walls stop your ride, and submerging uses your normal breath.
abilities.name: Breaker Wave

abilities.description:
Tidal Ascendance

Rise on a water column

Enter an empowered water form for eight seconds. Sea spell damage rises by 35% and mana costs fall by 30%. Costs 60 mana with a 30-second base cooldown. Hover near ground or water while casting; the column cannot carry you over a cliff.
abilities.name: Tidal Ascendance
